title: Transport all four geometric seeds in the coordinate control
status_note: Prospective experiment only; not runnable or published to cairn. Implementation, independent verification and a frozen protocol must land before ready promotion.

question: Do isomorphic models produce identical folded relation work when G, Q and all four geometric seed points are transported?
decision_value: This removes the known seed-selection confound in the completed coordinate experiment and determines whether any remaining difference belongs to arithmetic or to point-set selection. The result decides whether to retain coordinate models as a separate source of relation-yield variation in the next replication protocol.

resources.notes: Planning estimate only: ten gaps, both endpoints and two coordinate models give 40 IC attempts plus 40 rho controls. Three core-hours is a provisional allowance based on the existing isomorphic cohort, including cold setup and replay; rho remains diagnostic because its coordinate-hash partition changes.
